description_en: Performs a paged query for EIAM account information
description_zh: 调用ListUsers接口，分页查询EIAM账户信息
kebab_example: aliyun eiam-developerapi list-users --authorization Bearer_AT8csE2seYxxxxxij --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUsers

parameters.help_en: The authentication information. Format: Bearer ${access_token}. Example: Bearer ATxxxx
parameters.help_zh:
认证信息。
格式：Bearer ${access_token}。
示例：Bearer ATxxxx
parameters.name: authorization

parameters.help_en: The page number. The default value is 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of records to return on each page. The default value is 20. The value must be in the range of 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单页大小读取记录数，默认20，范围为1～100
parameters.name: page_size

data.description_en: The list of returned data objects

accountExpireTime.description_en: The time when the account expires. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
accountExpireTime.description_zh: 账户过期时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
accountExpireTime.title_en: 账户过期时间, 毫秒时间
accountExpireTime.title_zh: 账户过期时间, 毫秒时间

createTime.description_en: The time when the account was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
createTime.description_zh: 账户创建时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
createTime.title_en: 创建时间, 毫秒时间
createTime.title_zh: 创建时间, 毫秒时间

displayName.description_en: The display name of the account

email.description_en: The email address of the account

emailVerified.description_en: Indicates whether the email address is verified. A value of true indicates that the email address is verified by the user or set to verified by the administrator. A value of false indicates that the email address is not verified
emailVerified.description_zh: 邮箱是否已验证，true表示邮箱已经过用户的验证或被管理员设置为已验证，false表示未验证

lockExpireTime.description_en: The time when the account lock expires. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
lockExpireTime.description_zh: 账户锁定过期时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
lockExpireTime.title_en: 锁定过期时间, 毫秒时间
lockExpireTime.title_zh: 锁定过期时间, 毫秒时间

passwordSet.description_en: Indicates whether a password is set

phoneNumber.description_en: The mobile phone number of the account

phoneNumberVerified.description_en: Indicates whether the mobile phone number is verified. A value of true indicates that the mobile phone number is verified by the user or set to verified by the administrator. A value of false indicates that the mobile phone number is not verified
phoneNumberVerified.description_zh: 手机号是否已验证，true表示手机号已经过用户验证或被管理员设置为已验证，false表示未验证

phoneRegion.description_en: The area code for the mobile phone number. For example, the area code for a mobile phone number in the Chinese mainland is 86. Do not add 00 or a plus sign (+)
phoneRegion.description_zh: 手机地区编号,示例：中国大陆手区号为86，不带 00 或 +
phoneRegion.title_en: 手机地区编号,示例：中国大陆手区号为86，不带 00 或 +
phoneRegion.title_zh: 手机地区编号,示例：中国大陆手区号为86，不带 00 或 +

registerTime.description_en: The time when the account was registered. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
registerTime.description_zh: 账户注册时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒

status.description_en: The status of the account. Valid values: enabled: The account is enabled. disabled: The account is disabled
status.description_zh:
账户状态，取值可选范围：
enabled - 启用中。
disabled - 禁用中
status.title_en: 账户状态, enabled:启用,disabled:禁用
status.title_zh: 账户状态, enabled:启用,disabled:禁用

updateTime.description_en: The time when the account was last updated. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
updateTime.description_zh: 账户最近一次更新时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
updateTime.title_en: 最近一次更新时间, 毫秒时间
updateTime.title_zh: 最近一次更新时间, 毫秒时间

userExternalId.description_en:
The external ID of the account. This ID is used to map external data to the IDaaS account. By default, this parameter is the same as the IDaaS account ID.

Note: The external ID must be unique for the same source type and source ID
userExternalId.description_zh:
账户外部ID，用于外部数据与IDaaS账户的数据关联映射，默认为IDaaS账户ID。

说明：外部ID在同一来源类型和来源ID下唯一

userSourceId.description_en:
The source ID of the account.

For accounts created in IDaaS, the default value is the instance ID. For other types of accounts, the value is the enterprise ID from the source. For example, for an account from DingTalk, the value is the corpId of the DingTalk enterprise
userSourceId.description_zh:
账户来源ID。

自建类型默认为实例ID，其他类型，分别对应不同来源的企业ID，比如钉钉来源对应钉钉企业的corpId

userSourceType.description_en:
The source type of the account. Valid values:

build_in: The account is created in IDaaS.

ding_talk: The account is imported from DingTalk.

ad: The account is imported from Active Directory (AD).

ldap: The account is imported from LDAP
userSourceType.description_zh:
账户来源类型，取值可选范围：
build_in：自建。
ding_talk：钉钉导入。
ad：AD导入。
ldap：LDAP导入
userSourceType.title_en: 来源类型，build_in[自建],ding_talk[钉钉导入],ad[AD导入],ldap[LDAP导入]
userSourceType.title_zh: 来源类型，build_in[自建],ding_talk[钉钉导入],ad[AD导入],ldap[LDAP导入]

schema.title_zh: 查询账户列表响应结果
